attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Indiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false /result.in_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of Jan 1, 2024)

action_details.action_postfix: true /result.in_has_nexus xdef "Indiana filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)" job.audit_trail swap addto
true /result.in_has_nexus xdef "Indiana filing required: Economic nexus (exceeds $100,000 gross receipts threshold)" job.audit_trail swap addto
false /result.in_has_nexus xdef 0.0 /result.in_tax_liability xdef "Indiana filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IN requires addback of out-of-state municipal bond interest acquired after 12/31/2011.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.in_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.in_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.in_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.in_state_subtractions xdef "Indiana adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana corporate income tax. Applies Indiana flat rate (4.9%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.in_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.in_apportioned_income result.in_state_additions add result.in_state_subtractions sub 0.0 max /result.in_taxable_income xdef
result.in_taxable_income result.in_corp_tax_rate mul /in_tax_before_credits xdef
in_tax_before_credits result.in_state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.in_tax_liability xdef
result.in_estimated_payments result.in_tax_liability sub /result.in_refund_or_owed xdef
"Indiana taxable income: $" result.in_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Indiana tax liability (4.9%): $" result.in_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.in_tax_liability xdef result.in_estimated_payments /result.in_refund_or_owed xdef "Indiana tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.in_tax_liability xdef result.in_estimated_payments /result.in_refund_or_owed xdef "Indiana tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
